entry.title: New: dsh-voice-chat
entry.summary: Voice chat: 🎤 speech input (Web Speech, live editable interim results) plus 🔊 automatic/manual read-aloud replies (TTS), with voice, speed, pitch and recognition-language settings (Mandarin/Cantonese, etc.); fully client-side with zero keys, and Markdown is stripped before reading. Exact install spec: github:lak321/dsh-voice-chat. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
